title: blueprint-crafting plan-model
description: The normalized plan-model this skill freezes and hands to parallel-development. The handshake contract is the EXECUTABLE SUBSET (ADR #1): item_id / seq / depends_on / dod_ref round-trip losslessly with plan_queue.py's Phase -1 frozen queue. Every item field is classified into exactly one of three subsets (see $defs/subset_tags and infra/scripts/plan_model.py's EXECUTABLE_SUBSET constant): (1) executable — the lossless round-trip contract, consumed by parallel-development; (2) upstream_only — metadata this skill sources (complexity / risk / authority / ODP / constraints-profile / descriptive title/scope), tagged and IGNORED by parallel-development; (3) downstream_only — blueprint_subset, a code-execution concern with NO upstream source, left empty or 'downstream-filled' at round-trip. NOT globally isomorphic to plan_queue.py's queue (the field sets genuinely differ — ADR #1). Additively versioned: new fields optional + default empty; removing a field or changing semantics needs a deprecation transition + a re-run of infra/test/round_trip.py. Validated in infra/test/plan_model_schema.py.

plan_model_version.description: Schema version of this plan-model, e.g. 'v1'. Additive changes bump minor.

artifact_type.description: Which upstream artifact this plan-model normalizes. Drives the constraints-profile (I3 registry).

authority_chain.description: Ordered authority references (spec > blueprint > summary > companion). First entry is the master.

conflict_rule.description: How to arbitrate cross-artifact conflict, e.g. 'on conflict, authority_chain[0] wins'. Optional; defaults to first-wins.

items.description: The executable item list. For iteration-plan / executable-summary these are the queue items that round-trip with plan_queue.py. Each item carries the executable subset (lossless) + tagged upstream_only / downstream_only extensions.

subset_tags.description: Declares the three-way field classification (ADR #1) so a consumer knows which fields are the round-trip contract vs tagged extensions. Mirrored as a constant in infra/scripts/plan_model.py.

executable.description: item_id, seq, depends_on, dod_ref — the lossless round-trip subset.

upstream_only.description: title, scope, source_location, complexity, risk, odp_status, constraints_profile, parallel_group — tagged, ignored by parallel-development.

downstream_only.description: blueprint_subset — no upstream source; empty / 'downstream-filled' at round-trip.

item_id.description: [executable] Stable item identifier. Lossless round-trip field.

depends_on.description: [executable] item_ids this item depends on (DAG edges). Lossless round-trip field. Empty array when none.

dod_ref.description: [executable] Pointer to this item's definition-of-done (authority doc + section). Lossless round-trip field.

title.description: [upstream_only] Human-readable item title. Descriptive; not part of the lossless contract.

scope.description: [upstream_only] One-line scope / intent of the item.

source_location.description: [upstream_only] Where in the source artifact this item was extracted from.

risk.description: [upstream_only] Free-text risk note for this item.

odp_status.description: [upstream_only] Open Decision Points for this item (resolve-now blocks convergence; deferred may remain).

constraints_profile.description: [upstream_only] Which constraints-profile applies (e.g. 'iteration-plan', 'research'). Resolved against the I3 registry.

parallel_group.description: [upstream_only] Normalizer-inferred parallel wave / group. Null when sequential.

blueprint_subset.description: [downstream_only] Code-execution subset (e.g. AC ids). NO upstream source — this skill leaves it empty / 'downstream-filled'; parallel-development fills it. NOT part of the lossless contract.

odp.description: An Open Decision Point on an item.

kind.description: resolve-now blocks convergence (must be resolved); deferred may remain and re-surfaces downstream.

resolution.description: [upstream_only] Optional resolution text. A resolve-now ODP without a resolution is UNRESOLVED -> the constraints-checker (I3) Blocks convergence.

anchors.description: [upstream_only, document-level] Artifact anchor presence map: anchor-name -> {present, ref?, confidence?}. The normalizer extracts these from the source (latch: explicit anchor sections; semantic-infer: inferred); the constraints-checker (I3) verifies the required anchors for artifact_type are present. Absent entirely => the checker degrades to a coverage note (rule 3), not a failure.

present.description: Whether the anchor is satisfied in the artifact.

ref.description: Optional pointer to where the anchor is satisfied.

confidence.description: Extraction confidence (latch / semantic-infer) if anchor was inferred.

anchors_meta.description: [upstream_only] Provenance of the anchors map. source=author-supplied => the map is authoritative (a missing required anchor is a real Blocker). source=normalizer-extracted => the map came from heuristic keyword detection, so an UNDETECTED required anchor degrades to a coverage note (rule 4: no Blocker-on-a-heuristic-miss), not a Blocker.

source.description: How the anchors map was sourced: 'author-supplied' (authoritative — a missing required anchor is a real Blocker) or 'normalizer-extracted' (heuristic — an undetected required anchor degrades to a coverage note, rule 4).

research.description: [upstream_only] research-specific constraints-profile data (artifact_type=research). Carries claims (each citing fetched sources), sources (with provenance), a cost_ledger (budget vs used), and staging state. Checked by research_constraints.py (I4) against the ADR #7 v1 subset: sources-cited(b) / staging-via-convergence(b) / cost-bounded(b when exceeded) / provenance-tag(w). Idempotency + full trust-tier DEFERRED; fedaot-kb purity DROPPED.

claims.description: The synthesized research claims (each citing fetched sources via source_refs).

sources.description: The fetched sources backing the claims (each with provenance + fetched flag).

research_claim.description: A synthesized research claim. sources-cited (Blocker): source_refs must be non-empty and each must reference a fetched source.

text.description: The synthesized research claim — one verifiable proposition backed by source_refs.

source_refs.description: source_ids backing this claim. Empty => unsourced => Blocker.

source_id.description: Stable id for this fetched source; referenced by research_claim.source_refs.

ref.description: URL or stable reference to the fetched source.

fetched.description: True iff the source was actually fetched (not asserted). A claim citing an unfetched source fails sources-cited.

cost_ledger.description: cost-bounded: used must be <= cap on each axis; exceeding any cap is a Blocker (early-terminate).

tokens.description: Token-cost axis of the budget vs used ledger.

calls.description: Model-call-count axis of the budget vs used ledger.

sources.description: Fetched-source-count axis of the budget vs used ledger.

research_staging.description: staging-via-convergence: research must pass through staging AND converge before being frozen. A frozen artifact (in_staging=false) that has not converged is a Blocker.

in_staging.description: true = still in the staging queue (not yet frozen); false = frozen/published out of staging.

converged.description: true iff the convergence loop has passed on this research.
